Not by default. December 22nd falls inside the year-end code freeze, which runs Dec 15 to Jan 5 while Finance runs the annual close. No production release can go out in that window, hotfixes included.

The exception is a sign-off. A lead in #fin-eng has to approve the release in the channel before it goes out. Since Finance is the one asking for the fix, that approval may be easy to get, but it needs to be in writing in the channel first.

If you get the sign-off, a few other things apply:
- **Day of week:** Dec 22, 2026 is a Tuesday, so the "no Fridays after 14:00 UTC" rule doesn't apply.
- **Process:** Tag `vYYYY.MM.N` from main (here `v2026.12.N`) once the PR template checklist is complete. CI builds and publishes, so don't publish by hand.
- **Production approval:** Staging is promoted automatically. Production needs a manual approval in the CI UI from someone on the billing team, so line that person up ahead of time.
- **Migrations:** Any migrations ship in the same release as the code that needs them.

The other option is to release before Dec 15, which avoids the freeze. Today is Oct 2, so there is time if the fix can be ready by then.
